discovery_notes: Follow-up 5 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456, 489, 513); reuses their keys. 27 standard searches, snippets only; most values from search-engine summaries of fan bulletins (HKMSG) rather than quoted page text. New: HKDL January 2019 LEs (Sleeping Beauty 60th LE600; CNY Donald&Goofy, Cookie&friends, Minnie&Daisy, Mickey&Pluto LE500; Magic Access Mickey/Duffy LE500), Pin Trading Fun Night 2019 (Inside Out) items, Feb baby flower-egg LE600 (held), 14th-anniv Aug 10 phase (5 LE500), pre-sale bonus Russell/Remy, PIN-GO SE100; SHDR Fun Day frame set/Halloween float/mystery box; TDS Easter date/price corroboration. No existing holds released. Carousell and other resellers not used.
